ease.name: Ease (%)
ease.help: The ease is a percentage of the waist measurement. Default is 14%

sleeveType.name: Sleeve Type
sleeveType.help: Otis can be made with short or long sleeves.

snapPlacket.name: Snap Placket (%)
snapPlacket.help: This option controls the depth of the placket that holds the snaps.

hem.name: Hem (%)
hem.help: Hem determines the size of the hem on the sleeves.

binding.name: Binding (%)
binding.help: Binding determines the size of the binding for the neck and leg openings.
